name: Disk Keeper
author: ShadowOne
description: Free space in the bar, a warning before the disk fills up, and a panel to see and safely clean caches, old packages, build folders, Docker leftovers and large files.

barWidget.description: Shows free space on /, warns when it runs low, and opens a panel to clean up.

schema.label: Text beside the icon
schema.description: Free space (26G), percent used (81%), or icon only.

schema.label: Warn below (GB free)
schema.description: The icon turns red and a notification appears when free space drops below this.

schema.label: Critical below (GB free)
schema.description: Urgent notification, repeated at most every 6 hours while it lasts.

schema.label: Low-space notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when free space crosses a threshold.

schema.label: Check every (minutes)
schema.description: How often free space is read. Each check is one short process.
